items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We worked with Frankie Duesen a long time... [INTERVIEWEE] How was Frankie in those days? Was he pretty rough, or was he smooth playing, or how was he doing?

ctx.x: We worked with Frankie Duesen a long time. Frank played in the band together with Frankie.
How was Frankie in those days? Was he pretty rough, or was he smooth playing, or how was he doing?
